links.outcome: Accuracy, F1, and calibration error of Gemini ICL versus fine-tuned RETFound on the same DR data
links.effect: Gemini ICL accuracy 0.841 vs RETFound 0.849, F1 0.876 vs 0.883 (P>0.3). Calibration error 0.129 vs 0.081, RETFound better (P=0.004).
links.quote: While accuracy and F1 scores were comparable (P > 0.3), RETFound's calibration was superior (P = 0.004).

unlisted_practices: In-context learning (few-shot prompting) with a general multimodal foundation model as an alternative to fine-tuning a domain-specific model for data-efficient adaptation

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic classification performance and calibration of in-context learning with Gemini 1.5 Pro compared to a fine-tuned RETFound model on a retrospective benchmark dataset without testing a deployment practice.
